name: E-kassa.fi POS-system
author: noteshot

sections.description:
E-kassa.fi is perhaps the world’s easiest and fastest POS-system and it can be connected to WooCommerce.
This plugin speeds up the transfer of products data and enables the use of decimals in quantities.
The physical store’s POS system and WooCommerce online store work seamlessly together. Products, inventory and card payments.
Try the demo at https://e-kassa.fi/woocommerce-webshop-pos
sections.faq:
When/Why I need this plugin?

If you use the e-kassa.fi POS-system.

Is this free plugin?

Yes, this plugin is totally free.
